newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-MERRILL STARTS UES AS BUY.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-MERRILL STARTS UES AS BUY.

text.p: Merrill Lynch said it had initiated coverage of Russian national electricity company UES with a buy recommendation.
UES offered exposure to both the electricity generation and transmission sectors which had significant upside potential at current prices, it said.
In addition, as one of the top three Russian stocks in terms of market capitalisation and liquidity, UES would be a prime beneficiary from expected increased funds flows into Russia.

Merrill said more foreign funds were likely to enter the market over the next 12 to 18 months as the country became part of the IFC investible index in November and more positive economic news appeared in the coming months.
